title: ClusterExternalSecret `namespaces` list is deprecated in favour of `namespaceSelectors`
remediation: Replace `spec.namespaces` with a `namespaceSelectors` entry matching `kubernetes.io/metadata.name` on each ClusterExternalSecret named.
verifyCommand: kubectl get clusterexternalsecrets.external-secrets.io -o json 2>/dev/null | jq -r '.items[] | select((.spec.namespaces // []) | length != 0) | .metadata.name'  # each name still lists namespaces explicitly
